title: Local rank-one scalar extension and dual invertibility
statement: Let R to S be a ring sheaf map on an arbitrary site, with independent site and coefficient universes, sheafification in the module and internal-Hom universes and on all slices in the original module universe. If N is an invertible R-module sheaf, then its scalar extension is invertible, and the explicit evaluation map of [lem-sp-scalar-extension-dual-evaluation] is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose a covering family of rank-one trivializations from IsInvertible. The free sheaf on a unique type is the unit. For a trivialization e, define its basis vector by e.inv(1), its dual coordinate by e.hom, and their scalar extensions by eta(s tensor e.inv(1)) and the descended coordinate evaluation. Naturality follows from the trivialization and the sheafification unit. On every slice the composites are identities, using tensor generation via the locally surjective restricted sheafification unit and sheaf separatedness. The resulting extended trivializations witness IsInvertible over the same cover.

For each trivialization, explicitly invert the dual evaluation map: send a functional phi to its value on the extended basis, times the scalar extension of the local dual basis. Restriction of coefficients and the dual basis proves naturality. One composite is the identity by expressing an original functional in its dual-basis coordinates and testing on scalar-extension pure tensors. For the other, evaluate on an arbitrary slice and pure tensor; express the module section in basis coordinates and use linearity and commutativity of the scalar ring. These are actual inverse morphisms on every trivializing slice. Apply the cover-local isomorphism criterion to the underlying abelian sheaf, then reflect isomorphisms to module sheaves.

theorem scalarExtensionDual_localIsomorphism
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max uC vC u}]
    [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max uC vC u}]
    [∀ X, HasSheafify (J.over X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [∀ X, (J.over X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (α : R ⟶ S)
    (N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
    [N.IsInvertible] :
    (changeOfRingsOfUniverses α N).IsInvertible ∧ IsIso (scalarExtensionDualMap α N)
